dialogues.speaker: Nusta
dialogues.text: #Used to it already, eh, {NICKNAME}? We've got Melusines and Asha joining our teams of dancers this time. Look at them go. Gives you a real cozy feeling, doesn't it?

choices.text: Let's start the party!

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: Ahaha! That's the spirit! Unleash that passion and rock your body to the beat!

choices.text: Could I have a word real quick, Nusta?

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: Oh yeah, sure. First off, I've got good news—

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: Previously, I visited the Collective of Plenty to improve my boxing skills and enhance my core strength...

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: ...And I wound up taking the chance to practice playing the drums. Pretty good at it nowadays, if I do say so myself!

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: Master Iansan says that if I further improve my double pedaling and compound rhythms, I'll be able to play even more avant-garde pieces.

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: So, if you're looking to put a crew together and can't find a drummer...

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: I'd be up to help — if you'll have me, of course!

choices.text: It seems we're missing some friends this time, aren't we?

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: Hmm? Oh! You mean Taraneh and Uncle Scimitar?

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: Ah, it's a shame, but they've been super busy lately.

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: Something insane happened in Sumeru, and a huge relocation project was carried out in response.

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: Fortunately, I've heard that the danger has passed, and that they've moved back to where they used to live.

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: Moving's always a massive hassle, never mind if you've got to do it twice. Gotta sort your things, clean the house... Yeah, that stuff takes time.

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: And given their personalities, I wouldn't be shocked if Taraneh and Uncle Scimitar went to help others out once they'd settled their own business.

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: So instead, we've got some of the Blazing Beasts, who're having a rather relaxed time.

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: I have no doubt that they'll be the first to show up next time, though. I'll have the wine ready for them — already do, in fact!

choices.text: I'll swing by for a dance later.

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: No problem! Feel free to try the awesome food we've got at the party. Nothing like getting in the mood for a jig first, right?

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Ah, Barbara. I've been giving it some thought, and I think there are some moves we could improve on...

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Y'know, to help our Melusine friends go with the flow more easily, and help the little Saurians time their moves better.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Oh, sure. Let's check some medical books later and see how we can improve the motions that weren't designed for Melusines or Saurians, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: I'm sure we can come up with some bubbly, interesting, and easy-to-learn dance steps, just like last time!

choices.text: Kachina... and Barbara?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, this is an unexpected combination!

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: #Ah! {NICKNAME}, Paimon!

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: I thought it'd take longer for the news to reach the Adventurers' Guild, and for them to reach you from there...

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: But I'm glad that you're back so soon!

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: It seems like couriers abroad are really efficient, huh?

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Hey there, Honorary Knight. You're finally here!

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: If you'd arrived any later, the children would've finished listening to "Tumaini's Travels in Mondstadt."

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: ...Albeit without all the fascinating things I'd need your consent to talk about.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A—Ah, yeah... Like that whole bit with the Holy Lyre...

choices.text: Looks like you're getting along just great here, hmm?

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: I'd say I have Miss Mualani's passionate invitation and Kachina's patient introductions to thank for that!

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: It's only been a few days at the Easybreeze Holiday Resort, but I'm feeling quite at home already.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Isn't it just? A lazy day on a summer beach... Feels just like the Golden Apple Archipelago, huh?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Speaking of which, this is a pretty huge get-together, isn't it?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The venue was built just for this event, and we've got way more participants than last time — plus, they're from two extra countries!

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: When we first started, Mualani only thought of inviting Miss Nilou and her friends from Sumeru, like last time.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: But various things happened, and new participants kept arriving...

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: "Friends from Mondstadt" was something we thought might happen, but having Fontainians over sure was a pleasant surprise.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Manaia, who's lived with the People of the Springs for many years now, has invited the Melusines from her hometown to be her guests.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Hahah, behold, the surging tides of friendship.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What do you mean, "surging"...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh... Oh!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You mean... That once you have enough friends, surprises like these come surging out from time to time?

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Heh... This is the first time I've danced in front of friends from all over Teyvat. It's been a real test of my skills.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: It's also been incredibly fun, though!

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: I hope you'll enjoy this very special party too.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Some of the Melusines' and Saurians' movements were designed by Kachina and me.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Well, you're the one who put in the most work... You even pointed out all those, uh... profound anatomy details!

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Oh, don't be so modest, Kachina. I still have a lot to learn from you when it comes to more intense dance moves.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Well, if you think "Dance Event Choreographer" stands out a bit too much, or sounds a bit too load-bearing for the event's success...

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Let's be "Move and Groove Consultants" instead, shall we?

choices.text: Good going, Kachina.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: It's my pleasure! She's your old friend, and that makes her an honored guest here, too.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: I didn't do all that much, if we're being honest...

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: But if you say I was a big help, then I'm glad I was!

choices.text: Well, if it isn't my apprentice... and Mondstadt's idol?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Nilou, Nilou, look, the dessert this time is a sweet-sour berry roll based on Mondstadt's Apple Roly Poly, but with Quenepa Berry juice instead!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: You know, I've always thought that the sweetness of apples and that of Quenepa Berries would go together. Great opportunity to try it out, don't you think?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: It's also got Smetana from Nod-Krai in it. That should give it a unique texture!

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Nod-Krai?

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Miss Dori mentioned that many dishes from there have both some Snezhnayan flavor and their own distinctive touches...

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: And at her store, premium Smetana costs 150,000 Mora a jar.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Oh, Barbara brought the stuff. The Knights of Favonius in her hometown imported tons of ingredients from Nod-Krai, some of which I'd forgotten to buy previously.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: But 150,000 Mora a jar seems a bit pricey... How many watersports supplies could we purchase with that, I wonder?

choices.text: Is that delicious food we're discussing?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: One serving over here, too, please!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Oh, sure... Whuh!?

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: #{NICKNAME}! Paimon! When did the two of you arrive?

choices.text: About when you'd started talking about food.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That feels like it should be Paimon's line... Eh, whatever. You get to have it this time!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Alright, then. The Captain of the Guard and Patissiere Extraordinaire will be with you shortly, brand new dish in hand!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sorry, what "Captain of the Guard"?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Err... Oh, wait. This is something we were discussing previously...

choices.text: And Nilou was the "Girl Next Door."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! Paimon remembers Mualani calling Nilou the "Friendly Magic Teacher Next Door."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: She uses her own gentle way to break down deep truths so they click for everyone!

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: In that case, I suppose I'll try to play this role in earnest this time...

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: A guest by the name of Sedile asked me some questions about dance music — for instance, about how to dance along when you hear a new song.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: In other words, how to "improvise" in music and dance.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: To me, this is almost a matter of instinct. I can just... find the right rhythm and a suitable style when I move.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: But I'm still not so sure how to teach those who might have no experience at all.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Aw, don't worry too much about it, Nilou. Think about it this way—

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: It's not entirely wrong to call Melusines fairies of the nation of Hydro, right?

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: And fairies are really smart cookies, aren't they?

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: #And now that our lead dancer, {NICKNAME}, has arrived, Miss Sedile and the Melusines can just follow {M#his}{F#her} lead. They'll be fine!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: They'll pick the other basic dance moves up, easy-peasy!

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: #That's true... Last time, {NICKNAME}, you used subtle guidance to get them to execute the right rhythms.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: I believe you can do the same for the Melusines.

choices.text: Heh, just watch me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon wants to learn, too! If the dances aren't too hard...

choices.text: Call me the Master Melusine Mentor!
And Nilou was the "Magic Teacher."
Around the time when Smetana was brought up.
Save some for me!

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}! Having fun so far?

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Barbara and Miss Nilou have nothing but high praise for Mualani's Mondstadt-Natlan fusion food. If you're tired or hungry, you should definitely try it!

choices.text: I'm doing great! How about you?

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: I, well...

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: I'm kinda excited, actually.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Excited?

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Well, I've never really talked about dancing with friends from abroad before... Definitely not with two friends who're this amazing!

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Mualani told me all about Miss Nilou beforehand, so I knew what to expect.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Speaking with her feels like you're listening to a lullaby...

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Err, not in the sense that you'd fall asleep, but more... that your body and mind get so relaxed...

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: She's slow, gentle, calm, and so reassuring...

choices.text: That's quite true.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Haha, I knew I was on to something!

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: And then there's Miss Barbara. I was honestly a bit worried before meeting her...

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: After all, I've heard that she's Mondstadt's most popular idol. That makes her a superstar, right?

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: So I was thinking, would I upset her if I mess up in some way?

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Luckily, she turned out to be super easygoing as well.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Her vibe is a bit different from Nilou's. She feels more like a... bubble?

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Light, floaty, and shiny! That's the feeling she gives off.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Honestly, I didn't think I'd ever meet two more girls like Mualani.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Y'know, people who could roll with every dance move I suggested on the first try!

choices.text: Sounds like you've met your people, eh?

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Totally! I'll treasure this time we have for sure!

choices.text: Make sure to hang out with them more, alright?
An astute analogy.
And how are you getting along with them?

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: I... I realized that the two of them would mention all these techniques that I've never considered before...

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: In terms of time spent dancing and the number of performances they've done... Both are way ahead of me.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Though our dancing styles are different, I really want to learn from them and pick up new techniques.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: You've always taught me to push my limits and become a more well-rounded person...

choices.text: Did I say that?

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: You never said it directly, but I've heard adventurers from all over say that you can solve just about any problem.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: They also say that when it comes to... uh, academic qualifications, you would be rated as an expert in many different areas of study by artisans from Liyue, as well as academics from both the Sumeru Akademiya and that Institute thing in Fontaine...

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: And isn't there a saying in Liyue about "leading by example"? Well, I think you are doing just that!

choices.text: You've been learning a lot lately, Kachina!

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Haha, thanks! I'll do my best too!

choices.text: Looks like we'll have to push ourselves more from now on, too!
Huh. Strange, don't recall saying that.
I'll take a break first before continuing.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: O—Okay! Don't push yourself too hard, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Hello there, Honorary Knight.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: I only found out upon arriving in Natlan how much everyone here respects you. I'd say it sometimes beats how much Mondstadters respect you as the Honorary Knight.

choices.text: I just did what I could to help.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Speaking of which, I'd like to give you a bit of advice as a friend—

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: You can't always pour yourself into various commissions and focus solely on fulfilling the wishes of others.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: You've gotta take some time for your body and mind, too. Don't let that fatigue build up.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: You know... Like my sister does.

choices.text: Thank you, Barbara.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: This kind of relaxing gathering works great for that. You could definitely stand to organize similar events when you're with your friends in other nations.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: I've never had the chance to see you dance or lead dances before today. So if you don't mind, I'll help myself to a seat in the audience.

choices.text: I'll look out for myself.
I see you've made quite a few new friends, too.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Yeah! Everyone in Natlan has been such a pleasant surprise!

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: I didn't know that Miss Xilonen, who visited Mondstadt recently, was such a skilled craftswoman. I've heard that even the Archon goes to her to get tools made...

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: And to finally join the Dance-Off Stage for myself... Ah, it's truly marvelous.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: The way the sound twists and pulses with each turn of the knobs, and those constantly flashing lights... It gave me chills, but that was a pleasant feeling.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Miss Xilonen also gave me a record of some unique music. She said that Fontainian devices can also play said record.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: I'll make sure to listen closely to it once I get back.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Was Mualani the first to find you?

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: She was... and well, let's just say that I'm still getting my bearings on that one.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: When I first received her invitation, my reaction was... Well... "Is this some new type of scam?"

response.speaker: Player
response.text: "New type of scam?"

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Fortunately, as I read on, I could feel her passion through the words written on paper.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: I've heard my fair share of earnest prayers. Such sincerity, which comes from the heart, cannot be faked.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: And sure enough, when our caravan arrived at this stop, I saw her rushing over on a surfboard. That's when I knew...

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: "This is the person I'm looking for. I'm sure we'll make great friends!"

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: After that, she dropped all the work she had on hand and took me all the way from the People of the Springs to where the Children of Echoes live.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: We received some friends from Sumeru there, and then it was off to the Flower-Feather Clan to take a boat to this resort.

choices.text: Sounds like a great time.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: It was like a dream...

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Of course, we've still got plenty of time, so I'll make sure to continue enjoying my trip.

choices.text: That's very like Mualani.
How are things with Kachina?

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: To be honest, she reminded me...

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: ...Of me, when I'd just learned to dance.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Ah, I'm not talking about her skills, but more her state of mind.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: She loves dancing, and she practices hard, but she still gets stage fright when she's in front of strangers.

choices.text: Ah, you've noticed that as well.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Where dancing is concerned, her potential is well beyond her humble self-assessment.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Really, it'd break my heart if we couldn't polish that talent like a gem.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: I'll share all that I've learned with her. Hopefully, that can help her overcome those little shortcomings of hers.

choices.text: She's actually improved a lot since we first met.
Have you spoken to Nilou?

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Of course! She's a famous dancer from Sumeru, you know.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Even if I hadn't accepted this invitation, I'd have gone looking for her sooner or later — I am Mondstadt's idol, after all.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Dance knows no boundaries, and an idol must always push hers.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: That said, we haven't gotten to know each other as quickly as I did with our Natlanese friends.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Too many fun places to visit, maybe? Either way, we haven't had time to have a proper chat.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Her dance steps, though, give you a sense of natural grace, like a flower bud in the midst of blooming.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Dance steps are the most authentic way to reflect someone's personality, so I would guess that she's usually a quieter person...?

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: I think perhaps a soft approach to getting along with her might work best, in that case.

choices.text: I think you're easygoing to get along with, Barbara.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: After all, she's a friend from Sumeru and a famous dancer, too. I'd think there might be some differences in our cultural customs and personal habits, no?

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Jean reminded me to take note of that... Before coming here, I borrowed some books to learn the basics on Natlanese culture.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: That said, I didn't have much time to learn about Sumeru in detail this time.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: I should do my research over the next few days, maybe ask Mualani a few questions...

choices.text: I don't think you need to worry so much about that.
Do be careful of heatstroke.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Hmm... Are you worried that I'm wearing too many layers?

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Thanks! Still, I'm fine. The sea breeze here is really cool, and the temperature is quite different at night.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: I did ask my sister and father for their opinion before coming here, in fact.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Jean felt that, as a Deaconess of the Church of Favonius, it would be best if I dressed formally for my first public appearance in Natlan.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: As for Father, he reminded me that the sunlight here can be very intense, so I should watch for that.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: That's how I came to this party in the same clothes I wear to church, despite the heat.

choices.text: You have fun first, Barbara. I'll join you later.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Alright. See you soon!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: #Ya-ho! Hey there, {NICKNAME}. Here's your "Dance Party Captain of the Guard," reporting in!

choices.text: You've really gone all out this time, Mualani!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Oh, you mean inviting Barbara?

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Hehe, wasn't it a pleasant surprise to see one of your friends from Mondstadt?

choices.text: It was!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: If we had to do the math on this sequence of events... I guess we have Xilonen and Varesa to thank in the end?

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: They have a friend in Mondstadt who sent a postcard with Barbara drawn on it to Nepecha...

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Xilonen handed me the card, and I did some asking around, which led me to finding this amazing dancer from Mondstadt!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Once I knew, I just had to invite her over!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Otherwise, I'd never be able to shake the feeling that we were missing a crucial piece in our dance party puzzle!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: We've had friends from the Knights of Favonius visit previously. They're bold and courageous, and they got along great with us People of the Springs.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: It just so happened that I met a knight I had made friends with back then, and got them to send a letter through the Adventurers' Guild, which was delivered to Barbara.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Still, if we hadn't only just invited Nilou over from Sumeru and didn't have a million and one things left to set up...

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: I would've gone to Mondstadt myself. I mean, that would've been the earnest thing to do, right?

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Not to mention how I've been curious about Mondstadt for some time now. It seems like tons of fun!

choices.text: You're right on the money.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Anyway, I'm totally adding it to my list of tour destinations!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: After this dance party's over, I'll need to help Amina supervise the training of our new warriors...

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: And if all goes to plan, I can continue touring once that's over.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Look out now. You never know when I'll show up in a place both familiar yet unexpected, and surprise you!

choices.text: I wouldn't call it just "fun"...
I almost thought I'd come to the wrong studio.
Let's chat again later.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Hmm? Is your spirit stirred to dance? Go on then! Show 'em what you've got!

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: #You emanate joy today, {NICKNAME}. I'm happy for you.

choices.text: I'm happy for you too. You seem to have made some great new friends.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: #Thank you, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: This time around, I've stayed in Natlan for more than half a month.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Previously, it was my first time experiencing life outside Sumeru. I'd never even traveled very far at that time.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: And here at the Easybreeze Holiday Resort, I've experienced something quite different from my time with the People of the Springs.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Natlan really is amazing. Each of the six tribes has its own musical styles...

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: When Kachina took me on a tour of the Children of Echoes, I got to see their unique dance battles.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Some of their moves are really impressive, like the one where they push off the ground with one hand and lift their body into the air...

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: ...Or the one where they lie on their stomachs or backs and begin to spin rapidly.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: I never knew "strength" could be expressed through dance like that.

choices.text: Everyone's got their specialties.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Yes. I couldn't imagine what it would be like to do that dance for myself...

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Of course, it's probably not wise to force yourself to learn everything, but we can be open to new things, like Mualani.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: One's art must constantly seek nourishment to grow into something lovelier. Isn't that so?

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: On that note, I think I've learned a thing or two thanks to Deaconess Barbara from Mondstadt as well.

choices.text: From Barbara?

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: About the "energy" in dance.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: As you know, dancing was not supported in Sumeru in the past.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: This restriction has long since been lifted, but old habits die hard, you know?

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: As such, our songs and dances continue to prize wisdom, elegance, and beauty, incorporating no exaggerated movements.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Dehya says that this is what they call "cultural inertia." It's all a bit profound for me, though.

choices.text: It takes years for perspectives to shift.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: I see... So that's how it is.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: By contrast, Barbara seems much freer when she dances...

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: ...It's very cute, I'd say.

response.speaker: Nilou

dialogues.speaker: Enghiene

dialogues.text: ...That's why we have a little spice-flavored bean paste before eating desserts. It completely changes the taste experience.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: For example, Rose Custard, even the kind with sugar content reduced to one-third, will taste just as sweet as before, while its floral fragrance is intensified.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Huh. The medical texts that Miss Glenfidia brought back from Nod-Krai also mentioned this...

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: "Tiny amounts of spicy ingredients can activate one's sense of taste in various ways, enhancing the effects that seasonings have."

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Fontainian research also suggests that ingesting the right amounts of spicy ingredients can revitalize the body and quickly burn off extra energy.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Hmm, in that case, those spicy appetizers that I brought...

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: You can cut each small dried fish into two to three pieces — the perfect size for low-sugar desserts.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, looks like you're getting on just great, you two!

choices.text: Was it the topic of cooking that kicked this off?

response.text: I'd already reduced the sugar and cream content in the cakes, and drawn up a healthy morning exercise plan for the next few days...

response.speaker: Barbara

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: I wonder. Our time together has passed slowly, yet so quickly. A fulfilling time that has passed like a dream...

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: "Happiness isn't short-lived if we make happy gatherings a regular thing!"

dialogues.speaker: Sedile
